_purpose: The art-style catalogue the foundry forges against. Each style is TWO halves: `observables` are the measurable half (the style.py vocabulary a vision model can read back off any image, so adherence is a comparison of enums rather than an opinion) and `recipe` is the generator-facing half (what to tell an image model, concrete visual instructions, no proper nouns). A style enters as `candidate`; it becomes `proven` only through the cull, when a human keeps its renders across more than one craft problem. `evidence` is appended by /foundry commits and is the durable index the knowledge write-up reads.

_origin_kinds.readback: acquired from a best-in-class source by style.py multi-frame readback (style-onboarding-from-sample), then edited by hand -- the source frames never become references
_origin_kinds.authored: written from the attribute grammar directly
_origin_kinds.extracted: Read off a gallery by the Extract tab / pipeline/foundry/extract.mts: sources read back one by one, grouped by look, the recipe replicated from words alone with self-critique rounds and transferred onto a neutral scene, then KEPT by a human. Arrives with `exemplars` (source / replica / transfer files under foundry-out/extract/<run>/) and `origin.source` = the extract run id. Candidate until the forge's cull proves it.

styles.name: Painted 3D
styles.recipe: Stylised 3D characters with hand-painted matte textures and visible brush strokes on every surface. Heavy atmospheric haze softening the background. Blacks crushed to near-total darkness so only lit forms and a few saturated neon accents (electric blue, hot pink) read. One hard directional key with sharp planar highlights on faces. Clean graphic surfaces, no fine noisy texture, painted motion smears where anything moves.
styles.negative: photograph, photoreal skin, film grain, flat cel shading, text, watermark

styles.name: Cold Photoreal CG
styles.recipe: High-end pre-rendered cinematic 3D, physically convincing materials. A desaturated icy blue and dark steel duotone, dense cold mist hanging in the air, intricate gothic armour with micro-frost surface wear and scratches. Directional specular highlights, deep neutral blacks that still hold detail, subtle glowing blue emissive accents. Crisp edges, shallow cinematic focus, anamorphic widescreen framing.
styles.negative: painting, brush strokes, cel shading, cartoon, text, watermark

styles.name: Cel Anime
styles.recipe: 2D cel animation still. Flat colour fills with exactly two tones per surface -- a base and one hard-edged shadow -- and crisp dark ink outlines of even weight. Saturated, vivid colours. Painted background with soft gradients behind sharply drawn characters. No gradients on the figures, no photographic texture, no rendered volume; a hand-drawn theatrical anime key frame.
styles.negative: 3D render, photoreal, brush strokes, film grain, text, watermark

styles.name: Ink Graphic Novel
styles.recipe: High-contrast black ink graphic novel panel. Solid pooled blacks and stark white paper with almost no mid-tones, forms carved out of shadow by the light alone. A single spot colour -- cold blue -- used on one element only. Halftone dot texture in the mid-greys, rough brush-ink edges, heavy chiaroscuro. Flat, printed, no rendered volume, no photographic detail.
styles.negative: photoreal, 3D render, full colour, soft gradients, text, watermark, speech bubbles, panel borders

styles.name: Oil Concept Art
styles.recipe: Loose digital oil concept painting. Broad visible brushwork, edges lost and found -- detail concentrated on the focal figure and dissolving into suggested shapes elsewhere. Warm-against-cool colour split: a cold blue-grey world with one warm amber light on the subject. Lifted milky blacks, thick atmospheric haze layering the distance, matte painted surfaces with no photographic sharpness anywhere.
styles.negative: photograph, 3D render, cel shading, crisp digital edges, text, watermark

styles.name: Ember Lit Realism
styles.recipe: Photoreal CG render, cinematic and hyper-detailed. Materials read physically: micro-scratched metal, weathered leather, coarse fur, damp skin, each with accurate specular response and fine surface noise. A single dominant chromatic emissive — fire-warm or ice-cold — supplies the key and rims edges hard against a desaturated cold ambient. Deep neutral blacks hold shadow detail; highlights bloom only immediately around light sources. The air is thick with drifting embers, sparks, snow or ash catching that key. Crisp focus on foreground micro-texture, high contrast, restrained saturation elsewhere, filmic grade, no softening of contours.
styles.negative: flat lighting, pastel palette, cel shading, visible brushstrokes, lifted washed blacks, clean airless space, low detail surfaces, text, watermark

styles.name: Neon Wet Noir
styles.recipe: Nocturnal photoreal CG. Surfaces are wet, glossy and dark — lacquered metal, slick asphalt sheen, damp fabric — with sharp mirror-like speculars and reflected colour smeared across them. Two opposing neon hues supply nearly all the light: a hot magenta, red or amber against cold cyan, teal or green, rimming forms from opposite sides. Deep neutral blacks dominate; ambient fill is almost absent. Emissive elements bloom and halo, with soft trails and glow spilling over edges. Micro-texture stays crisp under the glare. Thin haze catches the beams. High contrast, saturated accents, polished filmic finish.
styles.negative: daylight, warm naturalistic sunlight, matte dry surfaces, pastel palette, flat ambient light, painterly brushwork, text, watermark

styles.name: Soft Backlit Bokeh
styles.recipe: Photoreal CG rendering with soft, diffused edges. Strong backlighting creating gentle rim highlights on surfaces. Shallow focus completely dissolving the background into smooth circular bokeh without hard geometric shapes. Fine airborne particles catching the light beam.
styles.negative: hard contrast, neon accents, crisp graphic edges, dense clutter, saturated palette, heavy grime texture, text, watermark

styles.name: Brushed Rim Painting
styles.recipe: Digital painterly illustration with visible, directional brushwork left unblended across the surfaces. Materials are plausible but built from strokes — slick wet planes catch broken specular marks, textures read as paint rather than as scan. A sharp rim light cuts hard along contours while cool ambient shadow fills the remainder, with warm side-light crossing the cool. The palette runs deep and saturated: cobalt, violet, dark teal and charcoal against warm beige accents. Blacks are deep and neutral. Airborne spray and fine particulate hang in the light. Edges stay crisp and deliberate despite the visible strokes; rich, hand-made finish.
styles.negative: photographic smoothness, airbrushed gradients, pastel washes, lifted milky blacks, flat ambient lighting, cel shading, text, watermark

styles.name: Crimson Flare Photography
styles.recipe: Cinematic photographic capture on a fast lens. A single saturated crimson practical dominates the frame, flaring and blooming where it strikes organic surfaces and dark textiles, throwing hot specular highlights and coloured spill. Cool white rim light separates forms from the background. Real optics throughout: light haze, gentle lens glow, shallow focus, fine natural grain. Materials are physically convincing — skin, woven cloth, matte black textile — with moderate incidental detail. Blacks fall deep and neutral, contrast is high, and the palette stays narrow: red, black, brown, cool white, warm flesh. Nothing illustrative in the rendering.
styles.negative: 3D render look, illustration, painterly brushwork, flat even lighting, pastel palette, desaturated grade, text, watermark

styles.name: Brush Textured 3D
styles.recipe: A 3D render finished like a painting: modelled forms and consistent CG lighting, but surfaces carry visible brush texture and hand-painted grain instead of photographic micro-detail. Materials read plausible rather than physically exact — no pore-level skin, no measured PBR reflectance. Soft directional key light from the side, deep neutral shadows, crisp contour definition at silhouettes. The palette stays desaturated and quiet: navy, slate, teal, warm taupe and muted rose, punctuated by small bright glowing accent points. The air is clear — no drifting particles, only faint haze. Shallow depth of field softens the background into blocks of tone.
styles.negative: text, watermark, photographic skin pores, physically exact reflections, floating embers or debris, heavy haze, bloom-blown highlights, saturated neon, flat cel shading, outlines, line art

styles.name: Volumetric Shaft Key Art
styles.recipe: A stylised-realistic 3D key-art render: forms heightened slightly beyond photographic truth, materials plausible rather than physically measured. Great volumetric shafts of light stream through mist and hanging haze, carrying heavy debris — spray, sparks, ash, drifting motes. A hard warm-cool split sets cyan and teal energy against warm sunlight, reddish leather and fiery trails. Surfaces are weathered and gritty; wet stone and scratched metal return detailed speculars. Blacks stay deep and neutral, edges crisp and defined, and deep focus keeps foreground and far background equally sharp across a densely dressed frame.
styles.negative: text, watermark, shallow depth of field, clean pristine surfaces, flat ambient lighting, desaturated monochrome, visible canvas texture, cel shading, outlines, motion blur

Light is driven by strong crimson backlighting contrasting against deep neutral blacks and crisp edge highlights. The palette follows a strict duotone of dark charcoal black and fiery rust red. Heavy environmental debris and floating embers drift through a dense, smoky atmospheric haze. Lens rendering exhibits a shallow depth of field with sharp foreground focus.
